landscape.summary: Stellar Soroban is solidifying its core financial layer with Protocol 20 smart contracts and the formal verification and liquidity expansion of Blend v2. Concurrently, broader DeFi credit markets are increasingly grappling with bad-debt contagion, liquidation design, and leveraged yield products. For a testnet credit infrastructure protocol on Soroban, the environment provides both clear integration specifications for Blend and strong macro justification for isolated account sandboxes.

themes.what_is_happening: Stellar is advancing smart contract capacity through Protocol 20 deployments, throughput upgrades, and the rollout of formally verified lending pools via Blend v2.
Market reports and educational coverage highlight severe fragility in pooled lending positions, cascading liquidations, and legal insolvencies during market stress.

themes.theme: Modular and Curated Credit Account Adoption
themes.what_is_happening: Credit protocols like Gearbox and Morpho are demonstrating sustained demand for isolated credit accounts and modular vault routing applied to structured yield and RWAs.
Liquid staking protocols across Solana, Sui, Avalanche, and NEAR are registering 30-45% weekly TVL surges.

quiet_on: Cross-venue unified margin primitives on Soroban outside of single-protocol lending pools.
Decentralized liquidation bot infrastructure and oracle latency benchmarks specifically for Soroban smart contracts.
Account abstraction implementation standards for credit delegation on Stellar.
landscape.for_vanna: The formal specification and Protocol 20 deployment of Blend v2 establish a concrete technical foundation for Vanna's testnet integration on Soroban. External market stress around debt bailouts validates Vanna's technical focus on isolated per-borrower SmartAccounts and deterministic 1.10x liquidation floors over shared-pool models. Vanna should direct immediate engineering focus to Blend v2 b-token specification alignment while operating on testnet.

strategies.title: Align SmartAccount with Blend v2 Specifications
strategies.move: Map Vanna's SmartAccount borrowing and collateral routing logic directly to the formally verified Blend v2 b-token contract architecture on testnet.
strategies.rationale: Blend v2 pool specifications and Protocol 20 smart contracts are now formally verified and live, establishing the exact integration interface for Soroban lending.

strategies.title: Validate Deterministic 1.10x Liquidation Mechanics
strategies.move: Run testnet liquidation simulations modeling stress scenarios to verify that the 1.10x health factor floor prevents pool insolvency without relying on ad-hoc bailouts.
strategies.rationale: High-profile DeFi liquidations continue to reveal systemic vulnerabilities in dynamic liquidation penalties and shared-pool collateral structures.
